name: The In-Between
source:
Two couples go on a hike on what they expect to be an enjoyable double date.  When they are unexpectedly separated, they are put to the test as they try to reunite with one another. 

[From [url=https://dracuclaw.itch.io/the-in-between]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两对情侣去远足，他们期待着一次愉快的双人约会。当他们意外分离时，他们在试图重新团聚时会受到考验。

[来自[url=https://dracuclaw.itch.io/the-in-between]Itch.io[/url]]
